name: skill-genie
description: Proactive skill development inside a live workflow. Before any task, ask: should this become a skill? A five-step checklist (repeatable, automatable, already ours, already someone else's, else create it), an order of operations for skill vs task (task first by default, writing delegated to a subagent), a reindex skill that makes a new skill available at once, plus an installer that puts the heuristic in your user-level CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md.
